message.content:
The most visited market in New York City is the **Union Square Greenmarket**.  
It’s the city’s largest and most frequented farmers‑market, drawing roughly 1 million visitors each year. The market operates every Saturday, Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday (and sometimes on other days during peak seasons), offering a wide variety of fresh produce, artisanal foods, and local products. Its central location in Union Square, combined with its reputation for quality and variety, makes it the go‑to destination for both locals and tourists looking for a vibrant market experience.
